title: Your first program: a message when your infobase starts
goal: Enter a small handler in the correct module, update the infobase and observe native output.
prerequisites: Your own empty file infobase opens in Designer. Start from zero explains normal installation.
outcomes: Explain the three lines of the first handler.
Distinguish saving, updating and starting the application.
Change the string and verify new output after another launch.
sections: The infobase has so far done nothing visible at startup. Add one action: display “Моя учебная служба работает” (“My training service desk works”). A message is immediately visible and needs no unexplained catalogs, arrays or functions. It creates no customers or documents. We are checking the specific chain from entered source to execution.

Enter the code in the managed application module. Select the configuration root, open its context menu and choose that module. Command placement can vary by version; use the managed application module, not an arbitrary common module. The platform invokes its startup handler when the application begins.

Процедура ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы() declares a startup-event handler. For now, know that the platform invokes it at application startup. Сообщить("Моя учебная служба работает"); displays the supplied text. Ordinary double quotes delimit the string and a semicolon ends the instruction. КонецПроцедуры closes the declaration.

The course explains the same Russian-spelling BSL source in English. Do not replace ordinary quotes with typographic ones. If the startup handler already exists, add the message inside it and preserve its other lines rather than declaring a duplicate handler.

Saving preserves configuration source. Updating the database configuration applies the definition used by the running application. Starting Enterprise mode invokes the handler. Ctrl+S alone therefore produces no new runtime message; starting without applying changes can execute an earlier version.

Use Ctrl+S, Configuration → Update database configuration (usually F7), then Debug → Start debugging (usually F5). Read proposed changes before accepting. A personal empty infobase gives no reason to accept deletion of someone else’s objects. Wait for startup and locate the application message area.
A changed version and a negative control

After success change only the message text, save, update and launch again. A changed output links observation to the new source version. If the old text remains, check the intended infobase and completed update instead of rewriting unrelated modules. Keep the working version available for return.

In a separate copy, a missing closing quote should produce a syntax diagnostic. Restore it before execution. This negative control checks diagnostics and does not justify damaging the main training project. The result is an observation of your launch, not an automatic knowledge assessment.

lab.title: The first native message
lab.environment: Your own infobase in the official training edition; no Studio, archives or JSON required.
steps: Select the configuration root. Right-click → Открыть модуль приложения (Open application module, as observed in 8.3.27.2214; another version may explicitly say managed application module). Preserve any existing text separately.
Enter the main example. If ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы already exists, add only Сообщить inside its body; do not create a duplicate.
Press Ctrl+S, then Update database configuration (F7). Wait for successful completion and correct any syntax diagnostic first.
Start Enterprise mode. Find “Моя учебная служба работает” in its message area and record the actual text.
Close your client, change only the message text and repeat Ctrl+S → F7 → F5. Compare both results.
expected: The intended module text window is open.
One new message with ordinary quotes is in the handler.
The application displays the intended text.
The new text appears and the earlier source remains available.
evidence: Three source lines and module identity.
Two actual messages from separate launches.
lab.negative: A missing quote in a separate copy should produce a diagnostic; restore it before launch. Diagnostics are not execution.

mistakes: I save and wait for a message.
Saving invokes no event; update the infobase and start the application.
Check the selected infobase, completed update and a new client launch.

examples.title: A minimal message

examples.explanation: The handler belongs in the managed application module; a source file alone does not invoke its event.

route.program: Designer → managed application module → Enterprise mode

steps.title: Open the correct module
steps.action: Select the configuration root. Right-click → Открыть модуль приложения (Open application module, as observed in 8.3.27.2214; another version may explicitly say managed application module). Preserve any existing text separately.
steps.why: The handler must reside where the platform invokes it.
steps.expected: The intended module text window is open.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not enter it in a query window or arbitrary module; check the window name.
steps.before: Designer is open only for your training infobase. Preserve any existing code before editing.

steps.title: Enter the minimal source
steps.action: Enter the main example. If ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы already exists, add only Сообщить inside its body; do not create a duplicate.
steps.expected: One new message with ordinary quotes is in the handler.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not replace unknown existing source; use your own empty copy instead.
steps.before: The intended module text window is open.

steps.title: Save and apply
steps.action: Press Ctrl+S, then Update database configuration (F7). Wait for successful completion and correct any syntax diagnostic first.
steps.why: The application uses the database configuration, not just open source text.
steps.troubleshooting: Check quotes and semicolons at the indicated line; a rejected attempt is not execution.
steps.before: One new message with ordinary quotes is in the handler.

steps.title: Start the application
steps.action: Start Enterprise mode. Find “Моя учебная служба работает” in its message area and record the actual text.
steps.expected: The application displays the intended text.
steps.troubleshooting: For old output close your client, verify the infobase and repeat updating. For no message check the module.

steps.title: Test a changed version
steps.where: The same module; then Enterprise mode
steps.action: Close your client, change only the message text and repeat Ctrl+S → F7 → F5. Compare both results.
steps.why: Link a source change to observable output.
steps.expected: The new text appears and the earlier source remains available.
steps.troubleshooting: Nexus does not automatically inspect the external window; record your own observation.
steps.before: The application displays the intended text.
